title: Rav Zaks Hospitalized
body: Rav Simcha Shmuel Zaks, nosi of Yeshivas Slabodka, hospitalized after cardiac episode at Maayanei HaYeshua Medical Center. Davening requested for refuah sheleimah for Rav Simcha Shmuel ben Esther Rivka.

title: Ponevezh Yeshiva Wake-Up Change
body: Ponevezh Yeshiva in Bnei Brak halted its early-morning wake-up system amid internal tensions over daily schedules, sparking conversation among bochurim. A notice posted in the dormitory announced the temporary suspension, leaving students wondering what's next.
